name: multi-cli-orchestrator
description: Orchestrate a task across specialized CLI subagents: delegate coding/implementation to codex (OpenAI Codex CLI) and design/image/icon/vector work to agy (Google Antigravity CLI), while Claude plans, dispatches, and integrates the results. Also includes a UserPromptSubmit hook that detects non-English prompts and enriches them with project-specific detail before Claude processes them.
